{"metadata":{"description":"面向长篇 RP 与陪伴对话的 DeepSeek Harness 记忆插件：给 AI 角色一份会淡、会不确定、只知道它该知道的事的记忆。本地优先，可选 MemU 引擎。","id":"gh:1437111047","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-memu-memory","slug":"Tkingxiao/dsh-memu-memory","topics":["ai-memory","character-ai","companion","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","javascript","memory","memu","plugin","roleplay","rp","webui"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"面向长篇 RP 与陪伴对话的 DeepSeek Harness 记忆插件：给 AI 角色一份会淡、会不确定、只知道它该知道的事的记忆。本地优先，可选 MemU 引擎。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"dsh-memu-memory"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A local-first memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness — shared by folder, bound to a chat,
written by the"},{"id":"p3s2","text":" agent, curated in the background, and honest about what it does not know."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"`dsh-memu-memory` is built for long-form RP and companion chats. It gives a DSH conversation a memor"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"y that behaves like memory instead of a log: three retention layers that fade, a first-turn anchor p"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"lus at most one per-turn recall, provenance that cannot be quietly upgraded from "I inferred it" to "},{"id":"p5s4","text":""they said it", contradictions that either wait for a decision or — when explicitly versioned — stay"},{"id":"p5s5","text":" side by side with a conflict card instead of being silently merged, near-identical facts collapse t"},{"id":"p5s6","text":"o one entry and one recall seat, and an optional relationship graph with evidence. Speakers, charact"},{"id":"p5s7","text":"ers, worlds and story branches form hard boundaries, and what a character is allowed to know stays s"},{"id":"p5s8","text":"eparate from what actually happened."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"It is **local-first by default**. The default `agent` backend stores full text in JSON indexes and r"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ecalls lexically — no Python, no embedding service, no API key. The `api` backend switches recall to"},{"id":"p6s3","text":" the optional, pinned MemU engine (vector search). MemU is a plugin for people who want it, not a re"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"quirement for the plugin to start."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"> [!WARNING]
> **Early-stage software.** This plugin is still early and may contain unforeseen error"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"s, bugs or breaking changes. Back up your data, and please report an issue or send a pull request — "},{"id":"p7s3","text":"feedback helps the project improve."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"> **Status:** 1.3.0. The first public release was 1.0.0. The manual now lives in `docs/`, with `AGEN"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"TS.md` as a short index. Back up `~/.dsh/dsh-memu-memory` before upgrades, and read Compatibility & "},{"id":"p8s3","text":"limits before storing data you cannot re-create."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Benchmark"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"The public chat-memory-benchmark full 714-question run (2026-11-06, `dys-router / deepseek-v4.1-flas"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"h`, high reasoning) passed **653 / 714 (91.46%)**. The run's actual measured memory cost was **¥16.0"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"5**; the full run, including non-memory overhead, cost **¥24.45** (75,517,851 tokens total, at the p"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"rovider's off-peak rate) — measured end to end, not extrapolated from a single session."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## What it remembers"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- **Three layers, one timeline.** `short_term` drafts expire after 72 hours by default; `long_term` "},{"id":"p12s2","text":"is the body of ordinary memory; `must_remember` needs a reason and a source, decays over 365 days wi"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"th a 0.35 strength floor, and can be *marginalized* but never auto-deleted to make room.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### Requirements"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| DSH | `>=0.2.0-rc.1` (web profile; verified on `0.2.2-rc.1`, 2026-11-05) |
| Node.js | `>=20.9` |
"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"| OS | Windows, macOS or Linux, wherever DSH's web host runs |
| Optional engine | Python 3.11+ **on"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"ly** if you choose the vector backend. The default backend needs no Python, no embedding service and"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"oose the vector backend. The default backend needs no Python, no embedding service and no API key. |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Privacy, permissions & data"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"**What is stored.** Everything lives under `~/.dsh/dsh-memu-memory/` (or `$DSH_MEMU_MEMORY_HOME`; th"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"e legacy `$DSH_MEMU_HOME` and `~/.dsh/dsh-memu` are still honoured when no new `state.json` exists):"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- **Text and images are not encrypted at rest.** The directory is inside your home directory. If tha"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"t is not acceptable, do not store secrets in memories and protect the disk with OS-level encryption."},{"id":"p18s3","text":"
- **Images are opt-in privacy data.** Only host-approved attachments are captured. `secret` entries"},{"id":"p18s4","text":" never serve their attachments over the HTTP route; `never_say` captions are not echoed. The vision "},{"id":"p18s5","text":"description service is enabled by default, but it only sends an image after you configure an endpoin"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"t, and it may cost money. It never uses host credentials automatically.
- **Network.** No telemetry."},{"id":"p18s7","text":" Outbound traffic happens only for (a) the optional engine installer downloading Python packages/uv "},{"id":"p18s8","text":"from the configured mirrors, (b) the embedding endpoint you configure, (c) the optional remote summa"},{"id":"p18s9","text":"ry model, and (d) the vision endpoint you configure (enabled by default; no call is made until an en"},{"id":"p18s10","text":"dpoint is configured). The default backend makes no external calls for memory operations.
- **Shell "},{"id":"p18s11","text":"and filesystem.** The optional engine installer uses Python/pip in a private venv (and a pinned uv f"},{"id":"p18s12","text":"allback inside the plugin directory). It does not modify system Python, install global packages or c"},{"id":"p18s13","text":"hange `PATH`. All memory writes are confined to the data directory; config writes use temp-file + re"},{"id":"p18s14","text":"name.
- **Deletion.** Archiving moves a memory out of retrieval; permanent deletion is a separate, g"},{"id":"p18s15","text":"uarded action for already-archived entries. Deleting a conversation only unbinds it; it never delete"},{"id":"p18s16","text":"s the library. Library deletion asks for confirmation and is backed up first."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Compatibility & limits"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- **Host:** DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.1`, using public extension points only (tools, injection, session query,"},{"id":"p20s2","text":" subagents, slots, a prefixed HTTP route). No host source modifications. The core surfaces (13 `memu"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"_*` tools, guide injection, settings page, right-sidebar tab, prefixed RPC) were verified on `0.2.2-"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"rc.1` on 2026-11-05; the check table lives in `docs/host-adaptation.md`. The optional dated-wake fea"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"ture uses the host-wide `ctx.schedule` task API introduced in `0.2.2`; on `0.2.0`–`0.2.1` (session-s"},{"id":"p20s6","text":"coped reminders) it detects the older shape and skips with one warning instead of retrying every swe"},{"id":"p20s7","text":"ep.
- **Recall quality:** the default backend is lexical. Semantic recall depends on the optional en"},{"id":"p20s8","text":"gine and the embedding model you choose; the plugin cannot improve a model it does not own. LongMemE"},{"id":"p20s9","text":"val, long-running group-chat A/B and "human-likeness" scores have **not** been run — test counts are"},{"id":"p20s10","text":" not a quality score.
- **No cloud sync, no accounts, no cross-device sync.** This is a local plugin"},{"id":"p20s11","text":" with no server-side identity.
- **Images without vision:** without an optional caption/vision endpo"},{"id":"p20s12","text":"int, an image memory is a pointer plus what a person wrote about it. The plugin does not claim to se"},{"id":"p20s13","text":"e pixels.
- **Poisoned v4 sessions:** historical `format v4 message requires a producer-owned source"},{"id":"p20s14","text":" kind` rows can be diagnosed but not rewritten; the plugin never edits private session files.
